hook: *14* KU B.Tech students fall ill after mess dinner
hook_b: *14* KU B.Tech students fall ill after mess dinner
tldr: At least 14 engineering students at Kakatiya University, Hanamkonda, fell ill from food poisoning after dinner at the common mess on Nov 19. Students protested at the main gate demanding quality food; SFI says the VC assured action against mess staff.

beats.what: 14 B.Tech students at Kakatiya University fell sick after the common-mess dinner.
beats.why: Students allege repeated requests for hygienic, quality food were ignored.
beats.care: Hostel students in Telangana depend on campus messes for every meal.

effects.label: VC assures action on mess staff

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Siasat (Nov 20): SFI and PDSO demanded action; the vice-chancellor assured students of action against mess staff.

cards.q: Should university mess hygiene inspection reports be made public?

qs: Who inspects university hostel messes in Telangana, and how often?

facts.t: Siasat reported *40* students fell ill after food at the University of Hyderabad the same day.

steps.e: 14 B.Tech students ill after mess dinner

viz.verdict: Two campus food-safety incidents in one day

watch: What action Kakatiya University takes against mess staff, and whether food is tested.

sources.name: Siasat
sources.title: 14 students fall ill after food poisoning at Telangana university

fact: *14* Kakatiya University B.Tech students fell ill after a common-mess dinner on Nov 19
twist: It was the second campus that day: Siasat also reported 40 students falling ill after food at the University of Hyderabad.
